summary: The prepared base already contains the solution from upstream PR #33140. It detects the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 checkpoint's official low/high/max contract and injects three distinct mappings. The local official prompts are byte-identical to the checkpoint encoder at revision 7872f01b1d1fe23eabc4c98b48bffcef5a386062, and the focused serving-path regression passes. No product source change was needed.

tests.what_was_measured: Existing regression coverage for official low/high/max prompt injection, omitted-effort defaults, preview compatibility, checkpoint profile detection, model-config override, and invalid-profile rejection; 4 passed and 131 were deselected.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-7b8a88b7e30d/venv/bin/python <AST comparison script against the downloaded checkpoint encoding/encoding_dsv4.py>
tests.what_was_measured: Checkpoint profile detection returned official; local low/high/max strings were byte-identical to the checkpoint reference (0/476/528 UTF-8 bytes), encoded outputs were distinct, high contained only the Absolute maximum prefix, max contained only Beyond maximum, and omitted effort equaled low.

The pre-fix parent had one REASONING_EFFORT_MAX constant and injected it only for max, with no Beyond maximum prompt, reproducing the reported static mapping defect in the actual historical implementation.
The assigned single GPU was visible as AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, with 270566162432 bytes total VRAM. This was inventory evidence only, not model execution.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU kernel or model inference was run. The issue is resolved in deterministic prompt/profile code and the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights were not available; using a different tiny architecture would not validate these model-specific semantics.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model weights were not available or downloaded, so full server inference and semantic output behavior were not tested.
The reported two-H200 tensor-parallel deployment was not reproduced; the assigned hardware was one gfx950 MI350X.
No multi-node or benchmark-quality claim is made.

Profile detection falls back to the preview contract if checkpoint encoder metadata cannot be read; the successful check here used the accessible checkpoint encoder file at revision 7872f01b1d1fe23eabc4c98b48bffcef5a386062.
